description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching Ronin Warclub to Crimson Kobolds.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Koll triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
